originalTitle: US woman who killed husband two decades ago admits murder of firefighter wife
summary: Yolanda Olejniczak Marodi pleads guilty to killing Rebecca Marodi, decorated fire captain who fought Eaton blaze
content: A California woman this week admitted to killing her wife, a decorated fire captain who fought the deadly 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, by stabbing her – the same fate she previously delivered to her husband and had served a decade in prison for. Yolanda Olejniczak Marodi, 54, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to second-degree murder after killing her wife, Rebecca “Becky” Marodi, 49, a California fire captain, at their home in February 2025, just a month after Becky, as she was known, battled the Eaton blaze that killed 19. Rebecca Marodi, who was assigned to the French Valley Cal Fire station in Riverside county was found with multiple stab wounds to her neck, chest and back at the couple’s home in Ramona, near San Diego. She had said she wanted to end the marriage. A warrant for Olejniczak Marodi’s arrest was issued days later. Detectives said home security footage had shown Rebecca Marodi running from her wife of two years, screaming: “Yolanda! Please! I don’t want to die!” According to investigators, Olejniczak Marodi, who was seen holding a knife and with blood on her arms in the surveillance film, replied: “You should have thought of that before.” Olejniczak Marodi was captured on video loading “pets, random items and some luggage” and loading them into an SUV, according to the warrant seen at the time by ABC News. About 75 minutes after the attack, records from homeland security showed Olejniczak Marodi crossing the nearby border into Mexico. Investigators later found that the then suspect messaged a friend: “Rebecca came home and told me she was leaving me. We had a big fight, and I hurt her. I’m sorry.” It emerged that Olejniczak Marodi had been in prison from 2004 to 2013 after being convicted of voluntary manslaughter in the 2000 stabbing death of her then husband Jim Olejniczak. He, too, had recently informed her he was ending the marriage. After she fled this time, Mexican law enforcement officers arrested her at a hotel in Mexicali in March 2025 and she was later handed over to US marshals in San Diego and booked on suspicion of murder. She initially pleaded not guilty. Andrea Winter, a friend of Rebecca, told the Los Angeles Times that Olejniczak Marodi was jealous of her wife’s popularity and exhibited “controlling, isolating behavior” before the killing. Winter said Rebecca had not disclosed that her wife had been convicted of stabbing her previous husband to death. “Yolanda was very insecure,” Winter told the outlet. “Becky has this magnetic personality and everybody liked her. I think Yolanda was very jealous of that and that Becky was this bright light.” She added: “Becky was a kind person and paid the absolute price for that by trusting the wrong person.” Olejniczak Marodi is scheduled to be sentenced on 2 September and faces 36 years to life in a state prison.
chineseTitle: 二十年前杀害丈夫的美国妇女承认谋杀了消防员的妻子
chineseSummary: Yolanda Olejniczak Marodi 承认杀害了参与伊顿大火的消防队长 Rebecca Marodi
chineseContent: 本周，一名加州妇女承认，她的妻子是一位获得勋章的消防队长，曾参与 2025 年洛杉矶山火的扑救，她的妻子因刺伤而被杀——这与她之前给丈夫的命运相同，并因此在监狱里服刑了 10 年。 2025 年 2 月，54 岁的尤兰达·奥莱尼扎克·马罗迪 (Yolanda Olejniczak Marodi) 在家中杀害了她的妻子、49 岁的加州消防队长丽贝卡·“贝基”·马罗迪 (Rebecca “Becky” Marodi)，周三，她承认犯有二级谋杀罪。就在一个月前，贝基 (Becky) 与导致 19 人死亡的伊顿大火作斗争。丽贝卡·马罗迪 (Rebecca Marodi) 被派往里弗赛德县法国谷加州消防站，被发现身上有多处刀伤颈部、胸部和背部在这对夫妇位于圣地亚哥附近雷蒙娜的家中。她曾说过她想结束这段婚姻。几天后，对 Olejniczak Marodi 发出了逮捕令。侦探们称，家庭监控录像显示，丽贝卡·马罗迪(Rebecca Marodi)逃离结婚两年的妻子，尖叫着：“约兰达！求你了！我不想死！”据调查人员称，监控录像中，奥莱尼扎克·马洛迪(Olejniczak Marodi)拿着一把刀，手臂上有血迹，她回答说：“你早该想到这一点。”据美国广播公司新闻网当时看到的搜查令称，视频中显示，奥莱尼扎克·马罗迪 (Olejniczak Marodi) 正在装载“宠物、随机物品和一些行李”，并将它们装进一辆 SUV。袭击发生后大约 75 分钟，国土安全部门的记录显示，奥莱尼扎克·马罗迪 (Olejniczak Marodi) 越过附近边境进入墨西哥。调查人员后来发现，当时的嫌疑人给一位朋友发了信息：“丽贝卡回家告诉我她要离开我。我们大吵了一架，我伤害了她。我很抱歉。”据了解，Olejniczak Marodi 在 2000 年刺死当时的丈夫 J 后被判故意杀人罪，并于 2004 年至 2013 年入狱。
